items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Jelly Roll Martin is New Orleans Jazzmen in a place that was red hot peppers like he used to call them

ctx.x: and was it Jasmine that started an interest again in New Orleans music or was it the so called Dixieland revival as it's popularly called with the issuing of some of the mostly records of people like Bunk Johnson

oh I don't know there was it's hard for me to say exactly there had been a lot of interest in New York in the type of music Sharky's band was up there at Nick's at about 1936 and of course Nick used a lot of the New Orleans people along with the Eddie Condon people people like Zutty and Boucher was there they would sometimes be in a different group Boucher for instance worked in the group called Spirits of Rhythm which he didn't like especially one thing they used electric guitars and he remember one night…
